questions.prompt: When he thought about his long career, he realized that his biggest ____ was in developing the new leaders of the company.
questions.explanation: Sau “his biggest” cần danh từ “achievement”, chỉ thành tựu lớn nhất trong sự nghiệp.

questions.prompt: She has ____ so much time and energy to the project that her name should appear on the award.
questions.explanation: “She has contributed” là hiện tại hoàn thành; cần quá khứ phân từ để nói lượng thời gian và công sức đã đóng góp.

questions.prompt: Hard work and ____ will help you move up the corporate ladder.
questions.explanation: “Hard work and dedication” ghép hai danh từ, nghĩa là sự chăm chỉ và tận tâm.

questions.prompt: There is no reason to question her ____ to our company.
questions.explanation: Sau “her” cần danh từ “loyalty”, chỉ lòng trung thành đối với công ty.

questions.prompt: These microchips are ____ faster and more cheaply in Asia.
questions.explanation: Vi mạch được sản xuất nên dùng bị động “are produced”; trạng từ sau mô tả tốc độ và chi phí sản xuất.

questions.prompt: Because you are a valued and dedicated employee, we are ____ you to director of the department.
questions.explanation: “We are promoting you” là hiện tại tiếp diễn, thông báo việc thăng chức đang được thực hiện.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (16).
questions.explanation: “Many” yêu cầu danh từ đếm được số nhiều “contributions”: nhiều đóng góp cho bộ phận.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (17).
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc “be able to + động từ nguyên mẫu” yêu cầu “to recognize”, tức có thể ghi nhận công sức.

questions.prompt: Chọn từ thích hợp cho chỗ trống (18).
questions.explanation: “Look forward to” đi với V-ing “welcoming”, diễn tả mong đợi đón người vào vị trí mới.

readingPassage:
Dear Harry,

We are pleased to inform you of your promotion within our company. Starting the first of next month, you will begin in
your new position as manager of the Fulfillment Department. During your years as a member of the Fulfillment
Department staff, you have made many [16] ____ to the productivity and smooth operation of the department. We have
always valued your dedication to your job, and now we are pleased to be able [17] ____ your hard work and fine skills
with this promotion. We know you will do a wonderful job. The Personnel Department will contact you soon regarding
the changes in your salary and benefits. We [18] ____ welcoming you to your new position next month.
Sincerely,
Madeline Kovacs
President

questions.prompt: When will the awards ceremony be held?
questions.explanation: Memo ghi lễ trao thưởng ở Merrimack Hotel vào Friday, November 10.
Memo gửi toàn bộ nhân viên và yêu cầu họ đề cử đồng nghiệp xứng đáng.

questions.prompt: Why does Marilyn Freeland think Janet McGhee deserves an award?

choiceTexts.C: She looks to others as an example.

questions.explanation: Marilyn nhấn mạnh Janet luôn làm nhiều giờ và cả cuối tuần để hoàn thành công việc.

questions.prompt: The word Obviously in line 9 of the first e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: “Obviously” biểu thị điều rõ ràng, gần nghĩa “clearly”.

questions.prompt: The word dedication in line 3 of the second e-mail is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: “Dedication” được minh họa bằng sự tận tâm và thời gian làm việc, tương đương “commitment”.

readingPassage:
To: All company staff
From: Claude Dubois, Personnel Manager
Re: Annual Awards Ceremony
It is time to start getting ready for the company’s
annual awards ceremony. It will take place at the
Merrimack Hotel on Friday, November 10. Up to 15
staff members will receive awards from the company
president that evening. We look to you, our company
staff, to help us select deserving award recipients.
Please send in your nominations for colleagues who
you think merit the recognition of an award.
Obviously, we would like to see names of people who
have contributed more than average to the company.
Send me your nominations by e-mail before October
15 so that we can have the list finalized before
November 5. Thank you.

To: claude_dubois@starco.com
From: marilyn_freeland@starco.com
Subject: nomination
Hi Claude,
I would like to nominate my coworker, Janet McGhee,
assistant manager of the research department, for an
award. Her dedication to her job is far above average.
She always works long hours to make sure she gets her
job done. If she is working on an important project,
she will come into the office on weekends if she thinks
it's necessary to completing her job on time. The rest
of us in the department always look to Janet as an
example of how to get a job done right. If anyone
deserves the recognition of an award for loyalty and
dedication, it's Janet. I hope you will consider her as an award recipient.

Thank you.
Marilyn
